notes.title: Lost Dunes Beta Test
notes.content:
Instead of the public demo, I will be holding a public draw for 5 people to beta test the game on February 7th, 4PM - 5:30 PM. I will email the winners with a beta steam code which will be revoked at the end of the demo. Emails for the winners will be sent out at 3:00 PM EST Feb 7th

[h1][b]Only signup if you can play during the Demo
[url=https://forms.gle/aEKcZGJXjrSHwoRR8]Click for Google Form[/url]
FEB. 7 4PM EST - 5:40 PM EST[/b][/h1]
